summary: Add HeroBanner, ShortcutRail and Billboard plus an opt-in Beta Header subpath for storefront assembly.
migration: Install the 0.2.0-candidate.1 / 0.1.0-candidate.5 pair and restart the project MCP. Keep existing imports. Opt into the sticky storefront header only via @yami/design-system/components/Header.
rollback: Restore the previously verified paired tarballs and consumer lockfile, revert newly adopted imports, then restart the project MCP.
visualAndBehavior: The homepage building blocks use the maintained layouts. Routes, artwork and storefront behavior remain consumer-owned. Review desktop and mobile with the host's own content.
